text: State the honest cost of TLS inspection.
choices: Every inspected session's security depends on the firewall's TLS implementation, which has historically been worse than browsers'; it breaks pinning and creates a single point where all plaintext exists
explanation: Several inspection products have been found downgrading cipher suites and failing to validate upstream certificates, reintroducing vulnerabilities the endpoints had fixed. The defensible position is selective inspection with documented exclusions.
